name: scripts
//: The repository's shell, Node and Python tooling, owned here by path so every script belongs to a project. Its `lint` is the repository-wide shellcheck, plus the check that every shell script checks out LF on Windows. It depends on sdk-contract because the SDK conformance scripts here (sdk-coverage.mjs, parity-audit.mjs) import that project's schema generator. Which project RUNS a script is a separate question each one answers through its inputs — the drift gates are ci-contracts, release-tooling, e2e-support and workspace; the installer is install-surface; the live and exploration drivers are the live-* and explore-* projects — so a script change selects this lint and the projects whose targets read that script, nothing else.
